metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a TruScan 128 Research EEG system using the 10-5 electrode placement, at a 3000 Hz sampling rate and with impedance kept below 20 kOhm. Mastoid electrodes served as references, and two channels were placed above and below the eyes for vertical EOG. Physiological signals (ECG, respiration, electrodermal activity, and corrugator EMG) were recorded at 4000 Hz with a BioPac MP160 system and AcqKnowledge 5.0 software. In the gambling game, participants made 144 dice-roll predictions with bets of 10 to 80 cents. The cognitive control task comprised 60 processing speed trials, 80 response selection trials, 160 response inhibition trials, and 160 conflict resolution trials.
